# dagsterplus_service_user (Resource)

Manages a Dagster+ service user.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "dagsterplus_service_user" "ci_bot" {
  name        = "ci-bot"
  description = "Service user for CI/CD pipelines"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the service user.

### Optional

- `description` (String) An optional description for the service user.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The service user ID assigned by Dagster+.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import a service user by its server-assigned ID
terraform import dagsterplus_service_user.ci_bot <service-user-id>
```
